properties.name: road_presence
values: both inside and outside the city
properties.description:
If a road is located within the city wall, choose intramural
If outside the city wall, choose extramural
If a road connects areas both inside and outside the city wall, select both inside and outside the city.
If none, choose none.

properties.name: wall_phase
properties.description: OPTIONAL: Use only if there are depictions of both the old (舊城/舊治) and new walls (新城/新治) of the same administrative units

entityTypes.description: A fortified structure surrounding the center of a civilian administrative unit (府，州，縣) to defend its inhabitants and buildings from external threats.

properties.name: bridge_type
properties.description: floating_bridge (boats floating as pillars), arch_bridge (rounded space between pillars), crossbeam_bridge (square space between pillars), basic_bridge (no pillars)

properties.name: bridge_pillar_quant
properties.description: Pillar is a vertical support structure that holds up a bridge. Count the number of pillars manually.

properties.name: bridge_cover
properties.description: If there is a bridge cover, select yes; otherwise no

entityTypes.description: A structure designed to cross a physical obstacle, such as a river.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Use Chinese character name if available. If not, follow the convention in the guideline.

properties.name: descriptor
properties.description: transcribe any annotations related to the obj_part except name.

entityTypes.description: a gate built over or at the entrance to a bridge
an outer defensive structure built in front of a city wall gate for additional protection
an entrance to the city as part of a city wall
a tower built over a city_wall_gate
a ditch surrounding a city wall, which may or may not contain water.
A tower built along a city_wall, but not above a gate
An outwardly projecting part of the main wall, either placed at corners or intervals along a wall.
A standing stone or wooden slab. Annotate it even if it is freestanding and separate from a bridge or a city_wall.
Any named or unnamed water features such as rivers, lakes, and ocean, except moat

properties.name: name
properties.description: use Chinese characters

properties.name: relation to wall
values: both inside and outside the wall
properties.description: If the water feature is located inside the city wall, select intramural; if this replaces part of the wall as the city's boundary (i.e. there is no wall where the water is, rather than the water simply running alongside it), select wall_replacement; if this is outside the wall, select extramural ; if this is both inside and outside the wall, select both inside and outside the wall

entityTypes.description: Any named or unnamed features of the earth’s surface such as mountains, cliffs, hills, and valleys

properties.name: name
properties.description: use Chinese characters

properties.name: relation to wall
values: both inside and outside the wall
properties.description:
If the feature is located inside the city wall, select intramural.  

If it replaces a section of the wall as part of the city's outer edge (i.e., there is no wall where the mountain, hill, or cliff is—rather than the feature simply running parallel to the wall), select wall_replacement.  
If it is outside the wall, select extramural. 
If it is both inside and outside the wall, select both inside and outside the wall.

entityTypes.description: a passage built into the wall that allows water to enter or exit the city
a self-contained walled structure attached to the main city wall body (關)
A shrine or a small temple built on city wall
